sections.text:
DSAI 130 is an analog input card (4 to 20 mA) used to connect current and 
 voltage signals

Analog input boards function in general as follows, the boards are provided 
 with a no. of channels, interference suppression, filtration and adaptation of
 The signal with respect to zero point and gain are performed individually in a 
 buffer amplifier. The A/D converts is multiplexed between the I/P channels. An 
 I/P channel is selected by the controller software by writing to a parameter 
 register, which also starts the A/d conversion the value converted to digital 
 form is then transferred via the parallel data bus to the controller software 
 for further signal processing. Zero point and gain must be adjusted manually 
 or by the controller software

The first draft initiated by eng. Ibrahim Ebaid Awad general computer 
 department & eng. Hussien Yousef instruments department High Dam power station.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the 
 qualified maintenance stuff should be carrying the suitable safety category.

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety helmet and shoes.
Unit must be shutdown.
Safety helmet, shoes

Hand held radio wireless 
 communications means
mA source to inject mA
Screw driver, nut driver
Isolating tape and test leads
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual.
Open panel no. 4
Using panel terminations identify the location for the desired card.

Using panel termination list for each card identify the two input wires for 
 the first channel
Using the screw driver, remove the two wires and isolate with tape
Connect the mA source leads to the first channel
Inject 4 mA, 8 mA, 12 mA, 16 mA and 20 mA according to 0%, 25%,75% and 100%

Compare the mV injected using radio with the mV reading in the DCS room (eng. 
 station)
If the reading is ok, or within the range (-+ 0.01 mV), repeat steps for another channel
If any reading for any channel in DCS not correct replace the card
Remove the mA source
Reconnect the input wires to terminal strip
Close the cabinet
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file
